title: Mr.Freitag Community Server Pack
description: This Modpacks adds a few Quality of Life features and a few Performance mods
body:
# The Mr.Freitag Community Server Pack 
This Modpack is a lightweight Minecraft modpack designed to improve quality of life and performance for multiplayer servers as well as client play. It’s built for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.10 and uses the Fabric mod loader, meaning it’s optimized for modern performance and compatibility with Fabric-friendly mods. 


This pack includes a curated selection of utility, performance, and quality-of-life mods that enhance the Minecraft experience without drastically changing the core gameplay. Key additions include:
Performance improvements with mods like Lithium, Sodium, and Sodium Extra for smoother frame rates and reduced lag. 


## Quality-of-life features 
such as Controlling, Inv View, Chat Heads, Clearer Slot Highlight, and Pick Up Notifier to make inventory and chat interactions easier. 


## Social and multiplayer enhancements 
like Simple Voice Chat for in-game communication. 


## Various helper and convenience mods 
including Mouse Tweaks, Zoomify, Armored Elytra, and Freecam. 


## Classic utility mods 
such as Just Enough Items (JEI) and JourneyMap to assist with crafting information and world navigation. 


This modpack is suitable for community servers, group play with friends, or general enhancing of survival gameplay without overwhelming players with major content overhaul mods — it keeps the experience familiar while making it smoother and more comfortable.
